demo-audio-01.title: Démo · Séparer des sources musicales
demo-audio-01.abstract: Audio source separation extracts individual instruments from musical recordings. Spectral decomposition represents music signals using frequencies and temporal patterns. A separation model estimates instrument components from the mixture and reconstructs each sound signal. Evaluation compares the separated audio with isolated recordings.

demo-audio-02.title: Démo · Réduire le bruit de parole
demo-audio-02.abstract: Speech enhancement removes background noise from audio recordings. Spectral representations describe the speech signal and separate useful frequencies from interference. The audio model learns temporal patterns in noisy mixtures. Evaluation measures the intelligibility of reconstructed speech and the quality of the separated sound.

demo-audio-03.title: Démo · Estimer le rythme musical
demo-audio-03.abstract: Music analysis estimates rhythmic patterns from audio signals. A spectral representation extracts temporal structure and instrument events from musical recordings. Rhythm estimation compares sound frequencies and repeated patterns in the mixture. The audio model detects beats and reconstructs the timing of musical instruments.

demo-audio-04.title: Démo · Reconnaître les instruments
demo-audio-04.abstract: Instrument recognition identifies sound sources in musical audio recordings. Spectral features capture frequencies and temporal patterns associated with each instrument. A separation model isolates components of the music mixture before classification. Evaluation uses isolated sound recordings to assess the quality of audio recognition.

demo-optim-01.title: Démo · Optimisation distribuée
demo-optim-01.abstract: Distributed optimization minimizes a convex objective across communicating agents. Each agent computes a stochastic gradient using local observations and updates its parameters. A convergence theorem bounds the error of the algorithm under smoothness assumptions. Numerical experiments compare gradient methods on constrained optimization problems.

demo-optim-02.title: Démo · Descente de gradient stochastique
demo-optim-02.abstract: Stochastic gradient algorithms solve optimization problems using noisy observations. The convex objective admits convergence guarantees under regularity assumptions. Each iteration updates parameters with a gradient estimate and a decreasing step size. A theorem bounds the expected optimization error and compares the algorithm with deterministic gradient methods.

demo-optim-03.title: Démo · Contraintes et régularisation
demo-optim-03.abstract: Constrained convex optimization balances an objective function with regularization terms. A proximal gradient algorithm updates parameters while respecting the feasible region. Convergence analysis establishes error bounds under smoothness assumptions. Numerical optimization experiments study how constraints influence the objective and the number of gradient iterations.

demo-optim-04.title: Démo · Agrégation entre agents
demo-optim-04.abstract: Communicating agents aggregate local gradient estimates to minimize a distributed convex objective. Stochastic updates allow optimization with partial observations. The convergence theorem accounts for communication delays and bounds the parameter error. Experiments compare distributed algorithms using identical constraints and optimization objectives.

demo-nlp-01.title: Démo · Classer des documents
demo-nlp-01.abstract: Text classification assigns categories to documents using language representations. A transformer encoder maps words and sentences into contextual embeddings. Semantic features help the classifier distinguish document topics from vocabulary alone. Evaluation measures classification accuracy on annotated text and studies ambiguous sentences.

demo-nlp-02.title: Démo · Rechercher des phrases similaires
demo-nlp-02.abstract: Semantic search retrieves documents that match the meaning of a query sentence. A language transformer produces contextual embeddings for words and text passages. The retrieval model compares sentence representations and ranks relevant documents. Evaluation uses annotated queries to measure semantic similarity across different vocabularies.

demo-nlp-03.title: Démo · Repérer les entités nommées
demo-nlp-03.abstract: Named entity recognition locates names and organizations in text documents. Contextual language embeddings encode each word using the surrounding sentence. A transformer classifier distinguishes entity categories from semantic features. Evaluation compares predicted annotations with manually annotated documents and studies vocabulary ambiguity.

demo-nlp-04.title: Démo · Résumer un ensemble de textes
demo-nlp-04.abstract: Document summarization selects sentences that represent the central meaning of text. Contextual embeddings from a language transformer identify semantic relations between words and passages. The model ranks sentences by relevance and removes redundant vocabulary. Evaluation examines whether selected text preserves the topics of annotated documents.
